_note: Which downloaded manufacturer model each part key uses (see vendor/manifest.json for URL + SHA-256). 'use': false keeps the behavioural fallback. Pin order is the subckt's node order.

1N4007.source: Vishay 1N4007 (second source for the onsemi part)

1N4148.source: onsemi 1N4148.lib (contains the 1N4148WT die model; stand-in for the DO-35 1N4148)

1N5245B.note: no manufacturer model; onsemi BZX84C15 proxy exists but behavioural 1N5245B fit is used (datasheet Vz/Zzt)

P6KE30A.note: no manufacturer P6KE30A model; behavioural datasheet-line fit with BV corners; Vishay P6KE27A model used only to validate the fitting method

ULN2003A.note: TI publishes no SPICE model; transistor-level behavioural channel

1N5817.source: onsemi 1N5817 (temperature parameters EG/XTI are odd fits; leakage when hot not relied on)

IRLZ44N.source: Infineon IRLZ44N (1996 Level-1; Vth 2.09 V vs datasheet 1-2 V: conservative for 3.3 V drive)

TL431.source: TI SLOJ174 TL431 macromodel (1992, DC; nominal Vref 2.494 V). The SLVM071 transient model needs ngbehavior=ps and is not used.

BC327.note: no manufacturer model reachable; behavioural PNP
